rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial pattern for compounds such as 口水腺 when relating something to saliva.

example.english: The doctor says my salivary glands are inflamed, so my mouth is always dry.
example.traditional: 醫生話我口水腺發炎，所以成日口乾。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 hau2 seoi2 sin3 faat3 jim4 so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 hau2 gon1

rows.note: Use this formal medical or written pattern instead of the everyday 口水 pattern, as in 唾液腺.

example.english: This report points out that insufficient salivary gland secretion causes dry mouth.
example.traditional: 呢份報告指出，唾液腺分泌不足會令口腔乾燥。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 to3 jik6 sin3 fan1 bei3 bat1 zuk1 wui5 ling6 hau2 hong1 gon1 cou3
